subtitle: Quran revision, on schedule
promotionalText: Meet Revo, your revision coach: ask how your week went, what to revise first, or how anything in the app works.
description:
Keep the Qur'an you've memorized. Revisely builds a daily revision schedule over exactly what you know, and keeps it going even when you miss a day. Free, with no ads.
• Revise page by page, even offline
• Time and record your recitation, or listen with a reciter
• Revo, an optional AI coach that knows your progress
• Activity calendar, insights and streaks
• Widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen: today's revision, the next prayer and the Qibla
reviewNotes:
Revisely is a Quran revision tracker. It is free, with no in-app purchases.

The demo account is pre-populated: about 166 pages memorized (Al-Fatiha and the last six juz), some of Al-Baqarah in progress, and seven days of completed revision sessions ending yesterday, with Smart Tracking turned on.

New since 1.0.4 (version 1.0.5):
- Mistake detection: open Read, any surah, and tap the mic at the bottom of the reader, then recite in Arabic. The page follows you. Hold the mic to turn on "Mark mistakes": mistakes are highlighted as you recite, and tapping one explains it. It needs the microphone and the internet; the checking runs on our server, the audio is processed in memory and never stored, and no person listens. The demo account has Premium, which is free for every account during early access: nothing is sold in the app.
- If you can't recite, the demo account has takes already: Activity (top right of Home) > yesterday > Recited > a take > Show on the page.
- Hold the mic > Test me: five random places in what the account has memorized.
- Activity > Insights also shows Recitation (takes over time) and Gaps (days between revisions).
- Revo, the optional AI assistant (the round R button at the bottom right of Home; answers come from Claude, by Anthropic, once the user turns it on), also knows what the user's takes show, as text, never audio.

Once signed in:
- Home shows today's revision. Tap "Start revision": the page fills the screen; tap it for the controls. Swiping past a page marks it revised (or tap the check at the top); ⋯ > Rate page strength rates it 1 to 5. Submit appears once every page is done, or swipe past the last page to finish.
- The bottom bar has two icon tabs: Home and Read (a separate Qur'an reader, with search).
- The icons at the top right of Home open the Prayer sheet, Activity and Settings.
- In a session or the Read tab, the bottom bar holds Play, the reciter, Audio Options, the microphone (tap to recite; hold for Record, Recite with Mark mistakes, and Test me), the eye (hides the page to recite from memory) and the timer.
- Recitation (hold a verse > Play, or Play in the bar) continues with the app in the background or the phone locked, with Now Playing controls on the Lock Screen and a mini player in the app; this is what the audio background mode is for.
- Hold a verse > Translation: Saheeh International, or The Clear Quran® by Dr. Mustafa Khattab (⋯ > Select translation), from the publisher's API (Al-Furqaan Foundation) under their developer agreement.
- Settings > Support > Report a problem sends a short report (optionally a screenshot) to our error monitoring service.

Permissions:
- Microphone: only when the user taps the reader's mic to recite (sent to our server to follow the page and find mistakes, as under Mistake detection above; never stored), taps record, or uses the microphone in the Read tab's search (voice search runs on the device and nothing is kept or sent). Recordings stay on the device and are backed up to the user's own account (Wi-Fi only unless mobile data is allowed; Settings > Activity > Back up recordings turns it off). Only that account can read them; deleting a recording deletes its backup.
- Location: only when the user opens prayer times or the Qibla (used on the device only, never sent), or turns on Start day at fajr in Settings > Prayer (then saved to the account to calculate local fajr).
- Notifications: the daily revision reminder, the end of a timed session, and prayer notifications if the user turns them on.

Account deletion: Settings > Delete account (at the bottom) permanently deletes the account and all of its data, including backed-up recordings (guideline 5.1.1(v)).

Qur'an page images: the Madani Mushaf rendered with the King Fahd Complex fonts (open-source quran.com-images), served from our own storage.
